summary: Investment analytics and reporting specialist with ~7 years of experience aligned to the Vice President, Performance Reporting & Analytics mandate: multi-asset portfolio analytics, exposure monitoring, and liquidity forecasting for institutional investors. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation and sensitivity outputs for client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Performed VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk attribution, and stochastic stress-testing analytics at Ortec Finance, presenting results to pension investment committees. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Liquidity Forecasting & Cash Flow Projection Modelling
Data Governance, Validation & Model Reconciliation Controls
Cross-Functional Delivery with Product & Technology Teams

sections.heading: Portfolio Analytics, Valuation & Exposure Reporting
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and exposure analytics delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level analytics feeding downstream client reporting processes.
Validated derivatives valuation outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, cross-checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on scenario impacts, exposure, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Liquidity Forecasting & Cash Flow Modelling
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across multi-year horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling liquidity profiling, funding optimization, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into projection scenarios.

sections.heading: Data Pipeline, Validation & Governance
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and audit trails, supporting data governance over client-delivered reporting.

Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Completed migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, advising clients on asset, liability, and reporting configurations.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation and governance documentation.
Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral, coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Delivered ALM and portfolio studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-horizon balance-sheet exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators supporting scenario analysis and stress testing of funding volatility and interest-rate exposure.
Presented study findings and strategic asset allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics across duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlays.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
